title: Interior guard phases
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |x|$. For any Boolean output string $out$ and natural number $u$ satisfying $0<u<\min(b+1,|x|+2-(j+1))$, after $u$ steps of the guard machine with parameter $b$ from the configuration at position $j$ in phase zero, the state is some phase $s$ that is neither phase zero nor the halting state.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is strictly less than the guard time of the specified initial configuration
